title: cpus histogram rounds to whole cpus, which misreads a run that drifts between 1 and 4

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bee2f5ca
notes.text: The cpus/time/share table bins each interval by round(cpus). A program that runs at 100-400% seemingly at random lands in bins that say nothing about it. Candidates: cumulative 'at least N cpus' shares, percentiles of cpus over wall, or bins of half a cpu. The sparkline on the screen is the current stopgap.
